scope: Inference-first operator/Block partition evidence; text prefill and autoregressive decode. Training constraints analytical only.

families.warning: Explicit head_dim may make Hq*head_dim different from hidden_size; reasoning thinking/nonthinking modes do not mean hybrid linear/full attention.

families.ffn: 128 routed experts/top8; no shared expert in original Qwen3-30B-A3B
families.state: KV cache plus routed token/expert queues
families.warning: Do not reuse Qwen3.5 shared-expert topology.

families.attention: 3 Gated DeltaNet layers / 1 gated full-GQA layer
families.state: linear layers: recurrent matrix + causal depthwise conv history; full layers: growing KV
families.warning: Whole hybrid model state still grows with context via full attention; not MLA; full q_proj includes output gate.

families.ffn: 256 routed/top8 plus sigmoid-gated shared expert for 35B-A3B
families.warning: text-only benchmark excludes vision tower and MTP.

families.attention: full causal GQA, no QK norm in official reference
families.warning: Use versioned Llama3.1 baseline; Llama4 exists as a separate MoE family and is not interchangeable.

shape_formulas.linear_logical_history_elements: B*(2*Hk*dk+Hv*dv)*(conv_kernel-1), while physical runtime cache convention must be measured
shape_formulas.naive_moe_dispatch_payload_elements: M*k*D each direction before local aggregation; topology/broadcast placement may lower traffic

partition_hypotheses.candidate: Keep Q/K per-head norm and RoPE with projection or adjacent vector epilogue, while retaining native KV-head cache.
partition_hypotheses.why: Normalization reductions are head-local; avoids exporting pre/post Q/K twice. Extra side ports for normalized Q/K, positional data and output gate must be priced.

partition_hypotheses.candidate: Keep score/online-softmax/value reduction and KV access within a head-group attention macro or tightly coupled local scratch.
partition_hypotheses.why: Cutting a materialized T*P score matrix is workload-dependent and can be quadratic; decode is a short query reading a long persistent KV prefix.
must_measure: read bandwidth per token and tail latency

partition_hypotheses.candidate: Fuse gate/up pointwise SiLU multiply at a shared intermediate channel tile; stream down-projection partial sums.
partition_hypotheses.why: The two M*F branches meet elementwise. Whole-FFN fusion may exceed storage; F-tiled grouping offers a tunable local interface.

partition_hypotheses.candidate: Reuse expert FFN tile; isolate top-k dispatch/weighted scatter and shared-expert path as explicit communication blocks.
partition_hypotheses.why: Irregular expert occupancy and k-fold dispatch change service rate and queue/storage headroom, independent of identical arithmetic kernels.

partition_hypotheses.candidate: Keep recurrent matrix update/readout near per-value-head state SRAM; separately assess QKV conv and scalar decay/beta epilogues.
partition_hypotheses.why: S_t read/modify/write is O(dk*dv) per head per token with recurrence. Splitting key dimension requires reduction/broadcast; head partition can keep state independent.

precision_and_scope: Numerical equivalence, traffic accounting and physical PPA are different claims.
Model config producer transformers_version != inspected source commit; both fixed separately.
Do not infer latest variants from family names; pin exact model/revision.
No MLA in the inspected Qwen2.5/Qwen3/Llama3.1 full-attention configs. Qwen3.5 GDN is recurrent linear attention, not MLA.

training_constraints_only.gemm_backward: Forward Y=XW; dX=dYW^T and dW=X^TdY change transpose and reduction destinations, weight update/write ownership and activation retention.
training_constraints_only.attention_backward: Softmax/RMS/RoPE backward and activation checkpoint/recompute affect storage; inference KV cache is not a training-backward buffer substitute.
training_constraints_only.moe_backward: Dispatch/scatter reverse paths, per-expert gradients and routing auxiliary losses require additional reductions; cannot assume inference-only fixed direction interconnect generalizes.
training_constraints_only.gdn_backward: Reverse-through-time/chunk recomputation requires state/activation reconstruction rather than only final recurrent state.
training_constraints_only.optimizer: Llama3 paper explicitly reports AdamW. Two FP32 moments alone cost 8 bytes/parameter; gradient, weight and optional master-weight precision are separate policy fields. No training execution in this round.
